features.name: Add User Page
features.description: Page for creating users and managing bank account assignments. Displays unassigned accounts with checkboxes for selection.

features.name: Unassigned Banks API
features.description: API endpoint that returns all banks where assigned_to_user_id IS NULL. Returns id, dbaName, accountType, and bankName.

features.name: Assign Banks API
features.description: API endpoint to assign selected bank IDs to a user. Updates assigned_to_user_id field.

features.name: Bank Management
features.description: Add bank form with account type selection and bank creation functionality.

features.name: Authentication
features.description: JWT-based authentication system with role-based access control.

features.name: Database Schema
features.description: Prisma schema defining Bank, User, Signer, Signature, and Check models with relationships.
